newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Land Bank of Taiwan seen reconsidering its FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Land Bank of Taiwan seen reconsidering its FRCD.

text.p: Land Bank of Taiwan may reconsider a plan to issue US$100 million in floating rate certificates of deposit, bankers said Wednesday.
The facility was expected to have a final maturity of three to five years.
Sources close to the transaction said the bank's funding requirement was not urgent and that the issuer considered the margin it would have to pay to investors "too high and unsatisfactory."
The issuer is 100 percent owned by the Taiwan government.
Bankers said they believed the issuer was hoping for pricing comparable to that of state-owned Bank of Taiwan's deal launched last November.
Bank of Taiwan's five-year US$200 million floating rate note issue paid an all-in return of 11 basis points over the London Interbank offered Rate.
